note: PIPELINE_HARD_RULES.md H9: no count may rise; a changed hash needs a stated reason and the owner's approval. Inputs are manus/golden/<board>/{prompt.txt,requirements.json}; mosfet's requirements were written by the mock Manus and contain one value the prompt does not state (board_width_mm), which Copper must ignore. esp32s3_leds (added in Step 2e) is the blocks path: manus/golden/esp32s3_leds/{prompt.txt,design.compose.json} -> compose -> C placer -> compile; its ERC 2 errors (power_pin_not_driven) and DRC 12 errors (drill_out_of_range, the module footprint's thermal vias) are the same classes as esp32's. Step 3b (2026-11-25): the KiCad project now carries the target fab's rules (copper-core project-rules), so the 12 drill_out_of_range errors on esp32 and esp32s3_leds (KiCad's default 0.3 mm minimum hole against the modules' 0.2 mm vias, which JLCPCB makes) are gone; drc_error lowered from 12 to 0 for both. No file hash changed. esp32s3_sensor (added in Step 3c) is the blocks path with a fine-pitch part (TMP102, SOT-563): it routes through the fine-pitch escapes; its ERC 2 errors are power_pin_not_driven, as on the other ESP32 boards.
